tasks.title: Increase build stage and per-task timeout constants
tasks.description: Change two constants: (1) In ralph-executor.ts, change MIN_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS from 5*60*1000 to 10*60*1000. (2) In workflow-loader.ts, change build stage timeout from 1800 to 3600.
acceptanceCriteria: 6-task build stage allocates 3600/6=600s per task (≥ 600s floor)
10-task build stage allocates 600s per task (floor overrides 360s)
